summary: Your mind moves in lightning. Thoughts and the urge to break form are fused, so you think in leaps, land on ideas other people can't see yet, and get bored of the obvious fast. You're wired for insight.
body: Your mind moves in lightning. Thoughts and the urge to break form are fused, so you think in leaps, land on ideas other people can't see yet, and get bored of the obvious fast. You're wired for insight. You can be brilliant, original, the one who solves what stumped everyone else, and also the one who interrupts, jumps ahead, or shocks people just to watch them react. The shadow is a mind so fast it won't slow down to listen. Pace it, and the genius lands instead of scattering.
gift: At your best: brilliant, original, the one who sees the answer first.
shadow: The trap: a mind too fast to listen, scattering insight it never lands.
integration: Let thinking and speech and freedom and disruption cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Strong for innovation, problem-solving, and tech; weak for routine detail and steady communication.
do: Slow down enough to land the idea
Listen as hard as you think
Aim the insight at a real problem
dont: Interrupt because you're three steps ahead
